Tixocortol Pivalate (BANM, USAN, rINNM)  JO-1016; Pivalato de tixocortol; Tixocortol, Pivalate de; Tixocor- toli Pivalas. 11β,17α-Dihydroxy-21-mercaptopregn-4-ene-3,20- dione 21-pivalate. Тиксокортола Пивалат C26H38O5S = 462.6. CAS — 61951-99-3 (tixocortol); 55560-96-8 (tixocortol pivalate). ATC — A07EA05; R01AD07. ATC Vet — QA07EA05; QR01AD07. (tixocortol) Profile Tixocortol pivalate is a corticosteroid with mainly glucocorticoid activity (p.1490). It is used as buccal, nasal, throat, and rectal preparations. It is reported to undergo rapid first-pass metabo- lism, primarily in the liver, and to have minimal systemic effect.
